explanations.title: Bounded provider calls
explanations.summary: Calls now validate required inputs, apply a timeout to each provider attempt, and retry temporary failures with backoff. By default, the gateway allows two retries.

explanations.title: Observable usage and cost
explanations.summary: Each validated call is recorded with its duration, attempts, usage, estimated cost, cache status, and any error. Cached calls are recorded with zero cost.

explanations.title: Prompt response caching
explanations.summary: The gateway caches successful responses using a key derived from the provider, model, prompt settings, and token limit. The default cache lifetime is 15 minutes; a cache hit skips the provider call.

explanations.title: Multiple provider adapters
explanations.summary: The package adds OpenAI and Anthropic HTTP adapters that translate provider responses into a common text, request ID, and token-usage format, plus a Bedrock adapter that delegates invocation to an injected implementation.

explanations.title: Retryable HTTP failures
explanations.summary: HTTP 429 and 5xx responses are marked as retryable, so the gateway can retry those provider failures while leaving other HTTP status errors non-retryable.
